I have uploaded a coding video where I go through an example of using decision trees, pruning, bagging, and random forests to predict the log salary of the MLB
hitters dataset. This example partially follows the coding lab at the end of ISLP, and also follows the examples that I showed in the meetup. 

Click below to watch the video:

* [Random Forest Vignette](https://youtu.be/mqmn8JqOgdA)

* [trees_bagging_rf_vignette_.ipynb](https://github.com/georgehagstrom/DATA622Fall2026/blob/main/website/meetups/meetup-8/trees_bagging_rf_vignette.ipynb) or
